attachments.text:
This is a WIP port of VimL's method call syntax: `base->method(...)`

Ref: <https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/12525|#12525>, <https://github.com/neovim/neovim/pull/14611|#14611>

I'm tempted to do this in multiple PRs to avoid a patch storm like <https://github.com/neovim/neovim/pull/15211|#15211> to make reviewing this easier.  
I was aiming for a relatively bug-free initial implementation in that PR which required _many_ patches.

However, method syntax seems to be quite bug-free from the get-go, with most patches only adding method call support to existing functions.

~Note that I probably won't aim to support using `v:lua` as a method here.~  
Changed my mind :smile:. `v:lua` may be used as a method like:  
`base->v:lua.table.func(...)`
